# Contributing

Suggest accounts, correct handles, improve translations, or fix the generator. Read the [curation policy](docs/curation-policy.md) and [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Submit a change

1. Open an [account suggestion](https://github.com/everclear077/awesome-ai-x-accounts/issues/new?template=account.yml) or [correction](https://github.com/everclear077/awesome-ai-x-accounts/issues/new?template=correction.yml), or create a focused branch from main.
2. Check the exact handle using a first-party source. Explain what readers can learn. Disclose self-promotion or a commercial relationship.
3. Edit `data/accounts.json` in English. Preserve names, handles, source URLs, and actual review dates.
4. Update the matching account in all four translation resources under `locales/`. Translate the description and every nonempty note. Check the source digest after reviewing the translation.
5. Edit locale resources or the shared template, never generated README files. Run the checks below and include regenerated files.
6. Use Conventional Commits, for example `feat(data): add evaluation researchers` or `fix(i18n): correct Japanese wording`. Keep unrelated changes out.
7. Submit a PR. Protected main requires the current `Catalog checks` result and resolved conversations. No direct push or force push.

```sh
python scripts/catalog.py build
python scripts/catalog.py check
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
git diff --check
```

Python 3.11+; no third-party dependencies. Windows users may substitute `py -3` for `python`.

## Review and licensing

Explain changed accounts, evidence, translations, checks, and unresolved doubts. AI assistance is welcome; describe how its output was verified. Inclusion is free and is not guaranteed. Unresolved identities stay in the [backlog](docs/research-backlog.md).

Contributions use the [MIT License](LICENSE). Submit only content you have the right to distribute; linked posts and trademarks retain their owners' rights.
